title: Annex 71 component-resolved physical-model runtime and error diagnostic

numerical_tolerances.pooled_temperature_rmse_c: less than or equal to 1.0 degC
numerical_tolerances.pooled_absolute_temperature_bias_c: less than or equal to 0.5 degC
numerical_tolerances.per_air_body_temperature_rmse_c: less than or equal to 1.5 degC
numerical_tolerances.thermal_balance_residual_w: less than or equal to 1e-7 W

known_deviations: This is a post-unsealing corrected holdout diagnostic, not pristine blind-validation evidence.
The pooled RMSE, pooled bias, and per-zone RMSE criteria fail; four missing outdoor-CO2 input rows independently fail the strict input-completeness gate.
The run is deterministic, conserves thermal energy, and does not use fallback, so numerical leakage does not explain the empirical residual.
The two-node-per-zone RC form collapses construction layers and the large internal door uses prescribed symmetric mixing rather than a pressure/buoyancy opening model.
The graph-derived mass-coupling correction reduces the largest excursion but does not improve pooled holdout RMSE, so it is retained as a topology correction rather than claimed as an empirical fix.
